newsitem.title: USA: US West Coast prods prices ease amid higher supply.
newsitem.headline: US West Coast prods prices ease amid higher supply.

text.p: U.S. West Coast products prices drifted down early Tuesday following lower futures prices and an increase in jet fuel supplies, traders said.
Jet fuel prices, which registered strong gains last week, added another half cent to Monday's losses, ranging 80.50/82 cents a gallon.
Values weakened following the arrival of imports and the return of jet-making unit at ARCO's Los Angeles-area plant.
Other distillates shrugged off the weekend shutdown of Paramount's roughly 8,000 barrel-per-day hydrotreater near L.A., citing its small size.
